DUS_summary: this section is about income & expenses
sub_rule_text: Verify borrower's annual income through tax returns and W2 forms for the past 2 years.

this section is about income & expenses and debt-to-income ratio
sub_rule_text: Maintain a debt-to-income ratio below 43% for qualified mortgages.

DUS_summary: this section is about valuation and property appraisal
sub_rule_text: Obtain independent property appraisal from certified appraiser.

DUS_summary: this section is about valuation and market comparison
sub_rule_text: Compare property value with similar properties sold in the past 6 months.

DUS_summary: this section is about valuation and valuation report
sub_rule_text: Ensure valuation report includes property condition assessment and photographs.

DUS_summary: this section is about management & exit and loan management
sub_rule_text: Monitor loan payments and flag any missed payments within 30 days.

DUS_summary: this section is about management & exit and exit strategy
sub_rule_text: Establish clear exit strategy including refinancing or sale timeline.

DUS_summary: this section is about management & exit and risk mitigation
sub_rule_text: Review and update risk assessment annually or upon material changes.
